messages:
maya: FYI AcmeCloud marketplace listing blocked by two things: finance says billing codes don't match our GL, and legal flagged SLA/CLA redlines. Can deal desk triage?
liam: Which billing codes specifically? finance callback was vague.
maya: They sent a CSV - vendor_billing_code vs our_product_code mismatch for 3 SKUs. Sam, you passed the product mapping earlier?
sam: I pushed a mapping but it used old sku ids. Re-generating now. Will post the new CSV in 10m.
anya: Legal saw an indemnity paragraph and a data residency clause we can't accept. They want: (1) indemnity cap aligned with our insurance, (2) DPA attached, (3) remove perpetual liability language.
liam: Procurement also needs the vendor tax ID and the marketplace PO flow doc. Marketplace requires PO -> invoice -> remittance mapping to their ERP. If those fields are missing invoices reject.
marketplace-bot: Validation error 422: invoice_schema.missing_field -> "seller.tax_jurisdiction"
maya: Ugh. The vendor (AcmeCloud) provided invoices with only country, not tax_jurisdiction. Liam, can procurement request a corrected invoice schema from them?
liam: On it. I'll ask them to include `tax_jurisdiction` and `billing_code` at line-item level. Sample payload they need:
```
{
  "invoice_number": "INV-2026-123",
  "seller": {"name": "AcmeCloud", "tax_id": "12-3456789", "tax_jurisdiction": "CA-ON"},
  "line_items": [{"sku": "RWD-API-1", "billing_code": "RD-API", "amount": 1200}]
}
```
maya: Also legal needs the executed SOW before we can push dedicated listing. Can sales lock that down?
sam: Customer SOW is mostly signed but pending one appendix (usage-based billing appendix). I'll follow up with the AE during stand.
anya: For the CLA/SLA redline I can offer a compromise: limit the indemnity to direct damages and add a 12-month cap tied to the last 12 months' revenue. If procurement/finance accept, we can move forward.
liam: Finance is ok with the revenue-tied cap but insists we get the correct billing codes in the invoice payload. No code -> automatic reject in our AP system.
maya: Timeline check — Acme wants go-live Friday. Is that feasible if we get updated invoice schema today and SOW appendix by tomorrow?
sam: Maybe. If AE confirms appendix EOD today and vendor updates invoices, we can do a soft-launch Friday but hold official go-live until legal signs final.
liam: I've pinged vendor procurement and CC'd their finance. Request sent: include `tax_jurisdiction` + per-line `billing_code`.
maya: Thanks. I'll track this in the deal desk board and tag you all. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm completion.
marketplace-bot: Ticket #MKP-8421 created for invoice schema error. Assigned to vendor_integration_team.
anya: tagging final: once appendix arrives I'll review and send an approval comment.
sam: AE confirmed appendix will be signed today.
liam: Vendor replied — they'll change invoice template and send samples within 2 hours.
maya: Great. Closing loop later. If anything stalls, escalate to partnerships leadership. :crossed_fingers:
